# agency-game-development

The **Game Development** division of [The Agency](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents): 21 specialist subagents for Claude Code, copied unchanged from upstream.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add efycacement/claude-kit
/plugin install agency-game-development@claude-kit
```

Restart the session afterwards. Plugin agents are namespaced: ask for an agent by name ("use the Blender Add-on Engineer agent to...") or pick it from `/agents`.

Without the plugin system, copy the files into your Claude Code config:

```bash
cp plugins/agency-game-development/agents/*.md ~/.claude/agents/
```

## Agents

| --- | --- |
